reviews.comment: This is for ENGL379, this class was incredibly difficult. The professor genuinely cares about her students. However, there is a lot of reading and discussion involved. She assumes you'll reread textbooks for the take-home exams, which took me 7 hours to finish the midterm as a studious person. Attendance is necessary. Lots of papers. Overall, okay.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I actually took Ms. Yoo for ENGL 379, and she is AWESOME. She is so kind, genuinely cares about your mental health. The books you can find online for free. Reading required outside of class, in-class discussions, take-home tests, and 5 short papers over the semester. Attendance is required, but it's not hard because she is so sweet and caring.

Ms. Yoo is the best writing teacher I've ever had. She gives very clear instructions and tips to practically improve essay-writing skills.  The homework load is easy, it's usually just reading an excerpt or writing part of an essay. It's easy to get an A in this class, just do the assignments. She's not an easy grader but she gives good feedback.

Prof. Yoo is nice, but this was far from my favorite class. It wasn't especially difficult (although there were a few times where I felt that the grading was a bit ambiguous) but it was not very interesting and there was quite a bit of homework, along with mandatory attendance. It's not hard to get an A, but I'm not sure if I would take this again.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I don't like English, but her class was great. She is so caring and very understanding, and when it comes to papers, she gives amazing feedback. If you need help, she will work with you. Lecture time consists of many class discussions over readings. No tests, just essays.
